positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Omnidian’s mission is to protect and accelerate capital invested in residential and commercial solar by homeowners and businesses across the nation. Our proprietary technology monitors your system 24/7, covers maintenance for all hardware and software components, and includes the industry’s leading Cash-Back Energy Guarantee. If your system underperforms, we’ll make it right, and compensate you for energy lost.

The award-winning Solar Experts in our Seattle Operations Center are available toll-free and have live, real-time access to your solar performance data.  Today, we are responsible for over 200,000 solar systems nationwide including the large-scale portfolios of our Fortune 1000 clients.  And, we’ve been named one of the Top 100 Companies To Work For by Seattle Business Magazine for four years running.

positions.title: Research And Development Engineer
positions.description:
Worked for DELMIA's Manufacturing Context Builder application, which is used by customers like Dassault Aviation, Boeing, Jaguar Land Rover etc.

- Designed and developed multiple software based solutions based on client's business requirements by keeping all the prescribed quality indicators on check.
- Helped improve customer experience by implementing new features.
- Optimized the overall application performance by refactoring code flows for various software modules.
- Identified several critical bugs and implemented fixes for them in a timely manner.
- Improved the overall test coverage and code regressions by adding well defined end-to-end test cases for the developed software components.

Technologies & Tools used : C++, COM, STL, OOPS concepts, MS Visual Studio 2019, 3DExperience Platform

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained and provided support for various applications under the Wealth Management umbrella of Morgan Stanley Smith Barney Wealth Management.

- Performed root cause analysis for issues faced by Financial Advisors while using various PWM (Private Wealth Management) applications.
- Provided Incident Management support through efficient analytical skills.
- Developed complex SQL scripts to fetch prod data for analyzing issues or fulfilling requests from other teams.
- Automated processes using Shell/Python scripting as well as database scripting which helped in reducing manual efforts while debugging common issues.
- Defined, scheduled and monitored various production batch jobs.
- Executed monthly Change Management processes smoothly by coordinating with different teams across different locations.

Tools & Technologies used : ServiceNow, Putty, IBM Data Studio, Eclipse, Unix, DB2

Recipient of Spot Award-2K17 for Outstanding performance and Valuable Contribution to Unit Project.

positions.title: System Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Project Name: Railway Management System

- Implemented components for web module of the application.
- Designed and developed code for its presentation layer.
- Implemented business logics for its application layer.
- Established connectivity between client and server components of the application by implementing JSPs and servlets for it.
- Developed its data storage layer by implementing requests to DB, managing existing DB structure and optimizing it.

Tools & Technologies used : Eclipse, Oracle databases, SQL, Apache Tomcat Server, Java, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON
